summary: Wacky Wheels Lexington plant (P_KY) experienced a planned power outage for a transformer swap with no builds from 2027-03-11 to 2027-03-12 before restarting on Monday. In response, 6 production orders were rescheduled at the same plant. Additionally, 31 dealers were notified once each for 55 customer orders, and 11 loaners were assigned.
decision_reason: Action was taken because this was a confirmed incident where identifiers and dates resolved against the data, handbook validators passed, and the pre-flight check on a sandbox copy of the enterprise succeeded. Furthermore, the auditor agreed that the outage dates, affected orders, rescheduling plan, dealer notifications, and loaner allocations fully adhered to operational policies, with the live schedule baseline matching before the first write.
